title: Fix Event Details refresh, hide location, support multi-sport and date range

requirements.text: Fix the issue where events created/edited using Voice Input do not reflect the latest values when viewing the Event Details page (ensure the Event Details view always displays the just-saved event data without requiring a manual refresh).

quotes: I see it takes the Voice input but not update on the details page.

acceptanceCriteria: After using Voice Input to populate fields and saving the event, opening the Event Details page shows the saved values (event name/type, date/time, organizer, payments, requirements, notes).
After editing an event (including changes coming from Voice Input) and saving, returning to Event Details shows updated values immediately.
No manual browser refresh is required for Event Details to show the newest saved data.

requirements.text: Remove the Event Location section/field from the Event Details page UI (do not display location in the details view even if it exists in stored data).

quotes: In event details page we don't want event location

acceptanceCriteria: Event Details page no longer renders the Location label/value or the location icon/section.
All other Event Details sections (date/time, organizer, payment summary, requirements, notes, actions) continue to work.

requirements.text: Support selecting multiple sports for a single event in the Add Event and Edit Event forms, and display multiple selected sports on the Event Details page.

quotes: And we need option to select multiple sports.

acceptanceCriteria: Add Event form allows selecting more than one sport for an event.
Edit Event form loads and allows modifying the previously selected multiple sports.
Event Details shows all selected sports (not just one).
Existing events that only have a single sport/event type continue to display sensibly (e.g., treated as a single selected sport).

requirements.text: Change event date input from a single date to a date range (from–to) for Add Event and Edit Event, and show the range on Event Details. Use English labels for the range fields (e.g., "From" and "To").

quotes: And for event date we need from when to when

acceptanceCriteria: Add Event form captures an event date range with a start (From) date and an end (To) date.
Edit Event form loads an existing event’s date range and allows editing it.
Event Details displays the date range in a clear From–To format.
Existing events without an end date continue to work (e.g., end date defaults to start date or displays as a single-day range).
Calendar sorting/highlighting and month filtering continue to function (at minimum using the range start date as the event’s primary date for existing logic).

constraints: Frontend must not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui or any paths listed in frontend.immutablePaths.
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor with all logic in backend/main.mo.
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Adding multi-user sharing or permissions changes beyond the existing single-user access approach.
Changing the offline sync architecture beyond what is required to make Event Details reflect the latest saved event data.
Removing the location field from the Add/Edit forms or from storage (only hide it on the Event Details page).
